title: Fixes AB#640874: Clarify Expense Agent scheduling permission error
summary: The Expense Agent scheduler authorization error message is now clearer, providing specific guidance to users about missing permissions and directing them to request 'Can Configure Agent' access from an administrator.
key_points: Ambiguous scheduler authorization error replaced with actionable guidance to ask an administrator for Can Configure Agent access
Message uses the localized field caption and Expense Agent Setup page caption as placeholders, with a translator comment
Both denial paths (no access control entry, or entry without Can Configure Agent) keep their existing rejection behavior
No changes to authorization, scheduling, permissions or schema
Wizard paths that reach the scheduler also show the new message
quote: Replace the ambiguous Expense Agent scheduler authorization error with actionable guidance
